CustomField.description: When checked, a recipient the message could not reach (not found in Microsoft 365, chat or message refused) is logged in OperationLog__c on the Record Id given by the caller. A send failure never stops the Flow.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to log, in Operation Logs on the record given by the Flow, the recipients the Teams message could not reach.
CustomField.label: Log Failures
